mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (review_content, rating, review_at, user_id, project_id) VALUES (#{reviewContent}, #{rating}, IFNULL(#{reviewAt}, NOW()), #{userId}, #{projectId})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND project_id = #{projectId})

SELECT rv.review_id, rv.project_id, u.user_name, r.reward_name, rv.rating, rv.review_content, rv.review_at FROM review rv JOIN funding f ON f.user_id = rv.user_id AND f.project_id = rv.project_id JOIN reward r ON r.reward_id = f.reward_id JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = rv.user_id WHERE rv.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY rv.review_at DESC, rv.review_id DESC
